integrity: All numerical checks are finite evidence; the unbounded statement is justified by the supplied proof, including the classical Kruskal–Katona theorem. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic hierarchy holds only with fixed tuple arity and edge threshold over induced friendship-graph parameters; it is a uniform logical-type count, not a sampling measure on graph vertices.
title: Friendship-base type spectra and a sharp edge-star condensation hierarchy
